description: This file defines structures and functions for discovering wide area gateways using DNS and Tailscale status, including detailed network probing, DNS querying, and the parsing of various responses. It manages discovery context and encapsulates DNS resolution, SRV and TXT record parsing, and filtering of tailnet IPv4 addresses.

classes.name: WideAreaGatewayBeacon
classes.description: Represents a discovered wide area gateway with various network details.

classes.name: DiscoveryContext
classes.description: Holds functions to retrieve Tailscale status and run DNS queries, used during discovery process.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Main function to discover wide area gateways within a specified timeout, returning an array of beacon objects.
